build_fast_rcnn_output_layers: build a FastRCNNOutputLayers module with two linear layers for box regression deltas and classification scores
run_fast_rcnn_inference: run fast_rcnn_inference on a batch of predicted boxes and scores with NMS and score thresholding
test_fast_rcnn_losses: test the FastRCNNOutputLayers losses method to compute classification cross-entropy and box regression loss
create_box_predictions: create predicted bounding boxes from proposal deltas using box2box transform apply_deltas on proposals
review_fast_rcnn_inference_single_image: review the fast_rcnn_inference_single_image function that applies score filtering and batched NMS per image
